verdict.rationale: Linear's public API is GraphQL, and its docs say the endpoint supports introspection 'so you can query the whole schema.' The full schema SDL is also published in the official linear/linear repo (packages/sdk/src/schema.graphql), which is a machine-readable spec equivalent to OpenAPI. Apollo Studio offers no-login schema browsing, and the schema carries @deprecated annotations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the published SDL downloads cleanly and stays current.
